faq.q: What time should we depart for a Starlite Festival concert?
faq.a: We recommend departing Puerto Banús 1 hour before the concert starts. This gives you time for a relaxed cruise along the coast, drinks and snacks, and return to port 30 minutes before showtime. The transfer to the Starlite auditorium takes about 10 minutes by taxi.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a Starlite pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (€749/2h, 11 pax) are ideal. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Are drinks and food included on the charter?
faq.a: Yes. Every charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. The skipper and fuel are also included. You can bring your own food or arrange catering via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can we extend the cruise after the concert?
faq.a: Yes, you can book a longer charter that covers both pre- and post-concert. For example, a 4-hour charter from 19:00 to 23:00 gives you a pre-concert cruise, concert time, and a late-night return to port. Contact us via WhatsApp to arrange.

faq.q: How do we get from Puerto Banús to the Starlite auditorium?
faq.a: The Starlite Festival is held at the Auditorio de Cantera de Nagüeles, about 10 minutes by taxi from Puerto Banús. Taxis are readily available at the port. We recommend booking a return taxi in advance.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for Starlite charters?
faq.a: Cancellations made 48 hours before departure receive a full refund. Within 48 hours, 50% refund. No refunds for no-shows. Weather cancellations are handled case-by-case; if the port closes, you get a full refund.

faq.q: Can we watch the concert from the boat?
faq.a: No, the Starlite auditorium is inland and not visible from the sea. The cruise is a pre-concert experience only. You disembark at Puerto Banús and travel to the venue by taxi.

faq.q: What should we wear for a Starlite yacht charter?
faq.a: Smart casual is typical. Bring a light jacket or sweater as evenings on the water can be cool. Comfortable shoes for the boat and concert. The boat has a bimini top for shade.

data.body_html:
Starlite Festival 2038 runs from July to August at the Auditorio de Cantera de Nagüeles, Marbella. Combine your concert ticket with a pre-concert cruise from Puerto Banús. Depart 1 hour before showtime, cruise the coast with drinks and snacks included, then return to port for a quick taxi to the venue. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and Spanish IVA.

Why a Pre-Concert Cruise Works for Starlite 2038

The Starlite Festival attracts top international acts each summer. A pre-concert cruise turns your evening into a full experience: you board at Puerto Banús, cruise past the Golden Mile and La Concha mountain, enjoy a glass of cava and snacks, then arrive at the venue relaxed and on time. No rushing from a hotel or restaurant — the boat is your private lounge for the hour before the show.

Our Fleet for Starlite Pre-Concert Charters

All boats depart from Puerto Banús. Choose based on group size and budget:

For Mangusta 80, the 4-hour minimum includes a free jet ski. Other boats (e.g., Ferretti 94, Pershing 46) are available — pricing on request via WhatsApp.

Sample Itinerary for a Starlite Evening

  • 19:00 — Board at Puerto Banús. Meet skipper, safety briefing.
  • 19:15 — Depart. Cruise east toward Marbella's Golden Mile.
  • 19:30 — Anchor near Cala del Faro for swim (if weather permits). Drinks and snacks served.
  • 20:00 — Return to Puerto Banús.
  • 20:30 — Disembark. Taxi to Starlite auditorium (10 min).
  • 21:00 — Concert starts.

Adjust times based on showtime. All charters include the skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

What's Included on Every Charter

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the cruise
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

No hidden costs. You can bring your own food or arrange catering via WhatsApp.

Booking and Cancellation

Book via WhatsApp at least 48 hours before the concert. Full payment required to confirm. Cancellations 48+ hours before departure get a full refund; within 48 hours, 50% refund. No refunds for no-shows. Weather cancellations: if the port closes, you get a full refund.

For more details on our full fleet, visit our boat rental Marbella page.
